dedupe_keys.name: dataset 6 aerpaw helikite spectrum measurements at packapalooza festival in august 2022

description: AERPAW at North Carolina State University publishes this experimental collection. The 27 August 2022 Packapalooza campaign measures spectrum occupancy and 4G/5G link quality during the festival at NC State. A helikite carries a portable node with two USRPs and records radio measurements with GPS logs. The source describes heights up to approximately 400 feet. The measurements capture changes during the event and support wireless spectrum-management and aerial-link studies. Coverage is limited to the described experimental campaign. The linked Dryad release is registered under CC0 1.0 and is publicly accessible without charge. Formats and variables are described by the provider; the files were not downloaded. Caveats include campaign-specific equipment and conditions, which limit transfer to other networks. Simulation use: Wireless spectrum and aerial-link planning. Related records include the NSF PAWR testbed platform, which describes the wider experimental infrastructure.
